name: world
description:
Information about the connected Foundry world and what the MCP may do in it.

Call with {"action": "<name>", "params": {...}}. Parameters: * required, ? optional.
- info(): Get basic information about the Foundry world and system
- permissions(identifier?, documentType?): Show Foundry world permissions by user role.
- capabilities(): The game system, the access level, and which gated features are on. Call it first.

name: documents
description:
Any Foundry document, in the world or in a compendium pack: an actor, an item or effect on an actor, a scene and its walls, lights and tiles, a journal and its pages, a playlist, a macro, a folder. Call schema first for the fields of a type in this world; kinds (inventory, spells, features) group the item types of an actor.

Call with {"action": "<name>", "params": {...}}. Parameters: * required, ? optional.
- schema(type?, subtype?): The types of this world, or the fields, subtypes and an example of one type; also the kinds of item.
- list(type*, subtype?, kind?, parent?, pack?, query?, filter?, fields?, …+2): List documents of a type, in the world, inside a parent, or in a pack; paged.
- get(type*, id?, name?, parent?, pack?, fields?, maxChars?): Read one document, or only some of its fields. A very large one is summarised.
- create(type*, subtype?, kind?, parent?, pack?, folder?, from?, data?): Create documents from data, or copy a compendium entry with from; inside a parent for embedded ones.
- update(type*, data*, subtype?, id?, name?, parent?, pack?, folder?): Change documents: one by id or name, or a list of changes that each carry an id.
- delete(type*, subtype?, id?, name?, parent?, pack?, folder?, confirm?, …+1) (delete): Delete one document, or several with confirm; a folder, with or without its contents.

name: actors
description:
What is more than a data change on an actor: a compact view, using an item or casting a spell, placing it on the scene, who owns it, the party and creature cards. Creating, changing and deleting actors and the items and effects on them is `documents`.

Call with {"action": "<name>", "params": {...}}. Parameters: * required, ? optional.
- get(identifier*): Retrieve character information optimized for minimal token usage.
- use(actorIdentifier*, itemIdentifier*, targets?, consume?, spellLevel?, waitMs?): Use an item, cast a spell or use a feature of an actor with the system's own rules.
- place(actorIds*, placement?, hidden?): Drop existing actors on the current scene as tokens.
- set-ownership(actorIdentifier*, playerIdentifier*, permissionLevel*, confirmBulkOperation?): Assign ownership permissions for actors to players.
- remove-ownership(actorIdentifier*, playerIdentifier*, confirmRemoval?): Remove ownership permissions (set to NONE) for specific actors and players.
- list-ownership(actorIdentifier?, playerIdentifier?): List current ownership permissions for actors, showing which players have what access levels.
- party-status(includeFeatures?): Compact live status of all player characters in one call (dnd5e or pf2e).

name: compendium
description:
Compendium packs: search, read an entry of any type, list packs, find creatures by criteria, and make or delete world packs. Entries of a pack are `documents` with `pack`; copying one into the world is `documents` `create` with `from`.

Call with {"action": "<name>", "params": {...}}. Parameters: * required, ? optional.
- search(query*, packType?, filters?, limit?): Search through compendium packs by name.
- get(packId*, itemId*, compact?): Read one pack entry of any type (item, actor, journal, roll table, scene, macro, playlist, cards, adventure); compact: true shortens it.
- find-creatures(challengeRating?, creatureType?, size?, hasSpells?, hasLegendaryActions?, level?, traits?, rarity?, …+8): MULTI-SYSTEM CREATURE DISCOVERY: Get a comprehensive list of creatures matching specific criteria.
- packs(type?): List compendium packs with their type, lock and write state.
- create-pack(label*, type*, name?): Create a world compendium pack.
- delete-pack(identifier*, confirmDelete*) (delete): Delete a world compendium pack (system and module packs are refused).

name: combat
description:
The combat tracker of a scene: read it, run it, and apply damage or healing.

Call with {"action": "<name>", "params": {...}}. Parameters: * required, ? optional.
- status(sceneIdentifier?): Round, turn and combatants with initiative, HP, AC and state.
- add(targets?, include?, sceneIdentifier?): Put tokens into the combat; creates the combat if there is none.
- remove(targets*, sceneIdentifier?): Take tokens out of the combat.
- initiative(mode*, who?, targets?, initiative?, sceneIdentifier?): Roll or set the initiative of tokens.
- advance(to*, sceneIdentifier?): Start the combat or move to another turn or round.
- defeated(targets*, defeated?, sceneIdentifier?): Mark tokens defeated (defeated=false undoes it).
- apply-damage(targets*, amount*, sceneIdentifier?, type?, multiplier?, allMatches?): Apply damage or healing to tokens (dnd5e or pf2e).
- end(sceneIdentifier?) (delete): End the combat by deleting it.

name: modules
description:
The Foundry modules of this world: what is installed and what runs, and switching them on or off. Foundry applies a switch only when the world loads again, so every browser has to reload (F5) afterwards; the bridge reconnects by itself.

Call with {"action": "<name>", "params": {...}}. Parameters: * required, ? optional.
- list(active?, query?, limit?, offset?): Installed modules with version, whether they run, and pendingReload for a switch that is not applied yet.
- get(id*): One module: description, authors, compatibility, what it requires and who requires it.
- set-active(active*, id?, ids?, withDependencies?, withDependents?): Switch modules on or off. Applied only after a reload of every browser. The bridge module itself cannot be switched off.
